Ribbon

The Ribbon is a solid brand-color field overlaid with soft, white, low-opacity "bayou current" strokes that sweep edge-to-edge across it. The static field+strokes SVG is always present (the no-JS / reduced-motion floor); on a capable client, animate overlays the WebGL2 core that flow-warps the strokes. The composition is chosen with the lines attribute (a named PRESET) or a raw integer seed — and because the static SVG and the animated tier are both generated from the shared line kit, they render the same composition. The field attribute overrides the field color per section (any CSS color). Use the header "Toggle theme" button to see light and dark (the strokes read more strongly on the darker field).

Variant gallery — named presets, animated. Same kit, different deterministic compositions.

lines="currents" (default)

lines="delta"

lines="bayou"

lines="crossing"

lines="weave"

lines="loops"

Raw seed — seed="42" (any integer is a valid, deterministic composition)

Field-color overrides — composition + per-section brand color.

Purple field — field="#7A2D8F" lines="delta"

Deep-teal field, higher intensity — field="#026252" lines="channels" intensity="0.9"

Static (no animate) — field="#00A3AF" lines="bend" (the reduced-motion / no-JS floor)

Fan divider (constrained-media accent — not the canonical device)
